# mewa base

> UI component system built with semantic HTML, design tokens, and vanilla CSS. No framework, no build step. Square, border-led, shadow-free.

## Canonical files

- Design tokens: `/ui/src/tokens.css` (light `:root` + dark `.dark`, tweakcn-compatible)
- Fonts: `/ui/src/geist.woff2`, `/ui/src/geistmono.woff2` (Geist variable, 400-550; the only fonts)
- Components: `/ui/components/{name}/{name}.css` (+ `{name}.js` only when interaction is needed)
- Component API reference: `/ui/components/{name}/component-skill.md` (markup, variants, ARIA, wiring)
- Documentation: `/ui/docs/` — one page per component plus a single Overview page (`index.html`)
- Legacy porting source: `/ui/legacy/` (previous hand-rolled mewa_ui; do not use for new work)

## Integration contract

1. Link `src/tokens.css`, then the stylesheets of the components you use:
   `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/ui/src/tokens.css">` and `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/ui/components/button/button.css">`.
2. Load a component's `<script type="module" src=".../{name}.js">` only when it exists (interaction alone does not imply a runtime dependency; native controls stay native).
3. Read the component skill and copy its HTML pattern. Components are configured with `data-*` attributes (`data-variant`, `data-size`, `data-state`, ...) — markup is the only API.
4. Icons: Lucide via the CDN script (`https://unpkg.com/lucide@1.8.0`), then `lucide.createIcons()`.
5. Dark mode: add or remove `class="dark"` on `<html>`. Every token switches automatically.
6. Do not invent tokens, radius/shadow values, or serif fonts. Geometry is square; circular shapes exist only where meaning requires it (avatars, radios, switches, progress).

## Visual contract

- Square, border-led, shadow-free. Elevation is expressed with `--border`, never shadows.
- Semantic color pairs (surface + foreground) from `src/tokens.css`; red, amber, and green communicate status.
- Focus rings via `--ring` with `:focus-visible`. All animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Components live in `@layer components` (typography also uses `@layer base`); author overrides outside the layers always win.

## Accessibility

Keep native form submission and fallback behavior. Do not remove labels, `aria-*` relationships, live regions, or keyboard instructions. Use `<dialog>` for modals, the popover API for dropdowns/tooltips, `<details>` for accordions. Respect reduced motion and forced colors. Provide a keyboard path for drag or pointer interactions.

## Legacy

`legacy/` holds the previous hand-rolled mewa_ui (`src/`, `snippets/`, `layouts/`, `catalog/`) as porting source only. Adapted components move into `components/` where they do not duplicate the base. Documentation lives in `docs/`, not `legacy/catalog/`.
